annotations.title: List Buyee and other proxy fees

description: List Japan shopping proxies in the fee dataset (Buyee, ZenMarket, Neokyo, Tenso, FROM JAPAN, White Rabbit Express) with transcribed service fees and unknown charges. Use this for questions about Buyee fees, proxy commissions, or which proxies are covered. Does not compute a shipment total — call estimate_landed_cost for an item plus postage.
name: list_proxies
